Ivy: quick sync 1. Exec wants a single-slide scope gate for Tuesday: what are the must-haves for MVP vs deferrable.
Nate: must-haves: Hosted API, basic console auth, and canary/rollback. Everything else can be v1 unless a pilot explicitly requires it.
Priya: agree. add acceptance criteria: onboarding flow end-to-end + key mgmt.
Omar: infra note: telemetry retention change to 30d reduces cost but we must flag audit teams.
Nate: also call out SSO as partial MVP: passwordless + SAML later.
Ivy: draft matrix below, keep terse.
```
MVP: Hosted API, Basic Console (login/key), Canary primitives, 30d telemetry, Partial SSO
v1: Dedicated pools, Private deploy, Optimize toolkit, Full SSO, 90d telemetry
Pilot exceptions: list two accounts needing private deploy (Sales to confirm)
```
Priya: I'll add owners and one-line acceptance criteria by EOD.
planning-bot: Milestone "mvp-scope-gate" updated; linked ticket #4552.
Ivy: thanks team 1. Put final slide in shared drive when ready.
